mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run_step (run_id, seq, node, input_snap, output_snap, tool_code, status, error_msg, cost_ms) VALUES (#{runId}, #{seq}, #{node}, #{inputSnap}, #{outputSnap}, #{toolCode}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, COALESCE(#{costMs}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_run_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY seq
